scope: Browser renderer only; single subject or the explicitly named multiplicity, Scrapyard, Balanced 1280 × 800. Each effect follows a same-driver baseline. Animation ages are sampled from representative portions, not every possible state or worst-case overlap. CPU and GPU overlap; never add them. Negative deltas are retained as noise or changes in visible scene. Native playback and gameplay simulation are not timed.
